{"content": "# Promotion evidence: Priya Raman, 1 January to 30 June 2026

Source: `git log` and `git blame` on this repository (`prettytable`, `main` branch). No code is quoted, because the committee cannot see it. All figures are counts from history. They measure activity, not impact.

## 1. Summary

In this period Priya delivered a JSON export feature with tests, a set of export options, a command-line flag for JSON export, a pagination explainer in the docs, and two bulk tooling commits. One feature, pagination caching, was built and reverted. Last, Priya rewrote the sorting tests.

Git history shows what was committed. It does not show design decisions, reviews outside commits, incidents, mentoring or user impact. Those need other evidence (see section 5).

## 2. What was delivered

| Date | Item | Size (lines) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 Jan | JSON export for tables | +60 | New module. All 60 lines still attributed to Priya at HEAD. |

| 10 and 12 Mar | Export options | +35, +12 | Merged to main through PR #41 (merge commit by Tomasz Varga, 18 Mar). |
| 14 Mar | Tests for JSON export | +90 | New test file. |
| 15 Apr | Pagination documentation | +40 | New doc page. |
| 2 Jun | Sorting tests rewrite | +55, −119 | See the caution in section 4. |
| 28 Jun | CLI flag for JSON export | +45 | Date is borderline (see section 4). |
